other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes target encoding on the entire training set without out-of-fold predictions, and then applies these features to train the final model on the exact same data. This introduces severe target leakage and causes the final model to drastically overfit.

summary: The agent generally implements a robust LightGBM pipeline with proper k-fold cross-validation, smoothed target encoding, and seed averaging. However, a critical target leakage error is introduced at the end: the final model is trained on target-encoded features computed directly from the full training set without using out-of-fold techniques, which will severely overfit the model and ruin test set performance.
